title: Bitcoin crashes to $59,000 as Anthropic falls 25% from yesterday’s IPO-day high
summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday for the first time since July as US technology stocks slid and Anthropic shares fell about 25% from their IPO-day high. Bitcoin traded at $59,470, down 5.66% over the previous 24 hours, according to CryptoSlate’s Bitcoin price data.
